nodes.name: Assign Owner (Round Robin)

parameters.query:
UPDATE contacts SET owner_id = (
  SELECT u.id FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN contacts c2 ON c2.owner_id = u.id AND c2.is_archived = false
  WHERE u.role = 'user' AND u.active = true
  GROUP BY u.id
  ORDER BY COUNT(c2.id) ASC, u.id ASC
  LIMIT 1
), updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING owner_id;

nodes.notes: Least-loaded among active role='user' reps — self-balancing, no cursor table needed.
